results.title: physics independent of characters / metadata
results.scope: STRUCTURAL: segments/crossing/places/effectiveSeed hashes of real V3 races before vs after 2 contracts were applied to frozen (read-only) segments; V3 files do not import the lab; no character words in physics sources; V3 files unmodified in git. Does not exercise a model change (none exists).

results.title: Bulldog 4 golden: P3 identity metadata == legacy frameFor/stateAt
results.scope: Exact equality of [clip, frame] on 5 presets x 5 dogs (1/96 s grid) + 300 random races x 5 dogs (1/48 s grid) + every segment boundary +/- 5e-10..2e-9. Dog4 pixel output is not rendered (no Dog4 assets in this checkout).

results.title: independence from FPS / evaluation order
results.scope: No clock/RNG/timer sources in lab src; results identical for ascending/shuffled/descending evaluation and for 5 sampling grids; frame at a 24-fps tick identical for 3 float constructions of the tick. A real renderer (rAF loop, interpolation) is not part of the lab, so rendering at different FPS is NOT exercised.

results.title: phase: RUN frame before STOP == STOP entry, on every real STOP and FINISH
results.scope: Real V3 races, Frenk contract applied to every lane. Checks label before STOP f1 = run96, first STOP frame = stop1, first tail frame = stop38. RUN lengths seen (frames) include the minimum 23.

results.title: no truncation: every clip fits its window
results.scope: FAIL is the honest result for the contract AS-IS: BUTTERFLY after STOP overflows by 11 frames at the original tempo. The tested retime variant (x1.0932) is reported separately and is NOT approved. ROLL has no Frenk clip: its windows are reported as MISSING_ASSET, not as a pass.

results.title: no sliding while the sprite stands (pre push-off) / paw contact
results.scope: PASS only for the pre-push-off crouch (visual idx 0..11): residual ground step of anchor+shift <= 0.05 px/frame in all 5 categories, driven by visualAt on real V3 physics. Paw contact in STOP, the STOP tail and RUN is analysed separately (analysis/stop_contacts.py) and shows sliding that this contract does NOT remove; see STOP_CONTACT_REPORT.md.

stopContactSummary.verdict: STRICT FAIL: stance paws slide in the window (RUN-level) and keep sliding in the stationary tail (frames 39-40 and 48-58, ~29 px total); foot-lock shift would need ~129 px of body travel (leash 39 px)

results.title: phase jumps at joins (START -> RUN #88)
results.scope: Computed metrics only (rollback <= 1 px, join step <= 2.7 px, join frames g3f35 -> run88, pair roughness as accepted by the architect). The visual (eye) acceptance has NOT been done; STOP -> action and action -> START joins are not measured here.

results.title: no advantage from clip length (mixed lane assignment)
results.scope: STRUCTURAL: results/places/crossing of V3 are unchanged for every placement of Frenk among Dog4 lanes. Win-rate per lane shown for information. The negative control (how much per-character physics WOULD change the odds) is in ../bulldog1-frenk/race_v3_character_contract_proposal/fairness_sim.

results.title: leash and finish: visual offset bounded, zero at crossing
results.scope: START shift arrays and the STOP tail baked body travel against the 39 px budget (smallest STOP-end-to-finish gap in 50,000 dog-runs = 3.34% of the course); at the analytic crossing time the sprite is in a RUN-loop frame with shift 0. STOP/tail shift is NOT defined (status UNDEFINED_NOT_BUILT), so the offset of the STOP tail is the clip own baked motion only.
